why_ai: Developers price entitlement, yield and cost risk on unique tracts and deliver physical lots through local councils, builders and subcontractors.
why_clarity: Lots delivered are countable, but every tract differs and whether the land price was right is known only at build-out, years later.
why_digital: Parcel data and plans are digital, but the product is graded, paved land sold locally to builders.

why_ai: Delivery depends on field crews, city inspectors and utility installs on site, and builders keep developers who hit dates.
why_clarity: A lot is deliverable or not by a contract date, phases repeat, and slippage shows within months.
why_digital: Progress data is partly digital, but the work and the product are physical lots sold to local builder divisions.

why_ai: Decades-long communities depend on place-making, builder relationships and judgement on pricing and releases against local competitors.
why_clarity: Sales pace is measurable, but release and pricing decisions are few, idiosyncratic and judged over years.
why_digital: Lots, amenities and model homes are physical and sold to builders and buyers who visit.

why_ai: Approvals are won in public hearings and utility negotiations where relationships, credibility and political judgement decide.
why_clarity: An approval is checkable, but each case is negotiated differently and the timeline is uncertain until the vote.
why_digital: Applications and studies are digital, but hearings and negotiations happen in person in each jurisdiction.

why_ai: Rezonings are decided by elected bodies in public, where the advocate's credibility and reading of the room matter most.

why_digital: Agendas and staff reports are online, but the decisive work is in-person meetings and hearings.

why_ai: Capacity is negotiated with utilities whose plant limits and politics make each commitment a judgement and a relationship.

why_digital: Capacity studies and letters are documents, negotiated with local utilities.

why_digital: Listings are online, but the product is physical land shown and sold to local and rural buyers.

why_ai: Encoding public ordinances into data is screen work that language models increasingly do.
why_clarity: Each jurisdiction's encoding is a repeatable, checkable task, though code interpretation varies.
why_digital: Inputs, production and delivery are all digital, sold by subscription and API nationally.
